tasks.short: Modify treatment plans in response to patient condition.

steps.what: Read current plan and recent response observations
Reassess the patient and discuss response and preferences
Choose nursing-plan changes within authorised clinical scope
Enter revised goals, interventions and response rationale
Verify clinical meaning and approve the final revision
Commit the approved nursing-plan revision

tasks.design: Configure the clinical-record category of {OTHER} with a response timeline and a revision form that carries forward unchanged plan fields. The nurse reassesses, chooses and verifies all changes; the form does not recommend treatment or modify prescribing orders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan editing can require reopening separate observation screens and retyping unchanged plan sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and versioned plan forms can reuse recorded facts.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting deterioration and determining whether a change is within nursing authority.
tasks.human_edge: Weigh symptoms, patient preferences and clinical risk together.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive plan editing; clinical decision rights remain unchanged.

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-15 for clinical governance, access and applicable national staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical-record views and plan forms can reduce navigation and repeated entry without choosing treatment.

assumptions: Boundary: nurse-owned plan revision after response, including assessment, decision, documentation and commit. New prescribing and carrying out care are separate work, not automated or counted as savings.

Existing care staff enter patient_id, observation_time, observation_type, value, units and author; current_plan_version and authorised_orders come from the clinical record. s2 produces fresh findings; s4 manually captures goal, intervention, frequency, rationale and review_date. Missing data keep manual navigation and entry.
Native configuration is tested first. Unchanged fields may carry forward only after the nurse verifies they remain applicable. No inferred clinical fact is inserted.
Same-system commit s6 is near-zero, represented by schema minimum 1% with all time retained. Shares are provisional work estimates independent of prompt priors.
Gross saving 11%; focal upkeep 1 hour per 100 baseline gives central net 10%.
research_questions: Does field reuse reduce typing without leaving obsolete interventions active?
Can a revision be tested against representative patient histories?

already_counted.description: Verify final clinical meaning and scope

incremental.description: Review stale fields and report plan-template defects

approvals.approved_version: approved plan revision v1 including patient, source version, goals and interventions; any edit invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% if existing screens already provide these functions and no change is deployed; 8% if incomplete histories consume two more baseline hours than the central 10% net scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe nursing practice and visit patients to check care quality.

steps.what: Observe nursing practice on the ward
Visit patients and assess their experience and condition
Discuss observed issues and direct immediate care corrections
Write and verify the care-quality follow-up note
Save the approved follow-up note

tasks.design: Use a short native follow-up form in the clinical or quality-record category of {OTHER}, with standard headings and selectable care areas. Keep visits, observation and corrective conversations intact; the nurse records and verifies the specific findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Free-form follow-up notes repeat headings and reference details.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing quality form can supply headings and selected record references.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising poor care and handling staff concerns fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Hear the patient's experience and intervene appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Documentation becomes slightly shorter; supervision rights and ward presence are unchanged.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10 for access and national consultation if staff monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured quality-note forms can reduce repeated headings and record-reference entry.

assumptions: Boundary includes focal nurse observation, patient visits, corrective discussion and brief follow-up recording. Other nurses' care delivery is unchanged and not saved.

s1 and s2 produce findings directly; s4 captures visit_time, patient_or_location_reference, care_area, observed_fact, action and follow_up_owner. No machine infers findings from schedules. Missing reference fields are entered manually.
Test a native form first. Savings touch only heading/reference entry in s4, not observation, judgements or talking. s5 is a near-zero same-system save with minimum 1% fully retained.
Gross saving 2.7%; focal upkeep 0.5 gives net 2.2%. No ambient recording is needed.
unknowns: Whether visit findings already use a structured form
research_questions: Does the shorter form preserve useful follow-up detail?

already_counted.description: Enter and verify actual findings and follow-up

incremental.description: Maintain form choices and report missing headings

approvals.approved_version: approved follow-up note v1 with final factual text, action and record reference; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% when a suitable form already exists and no change is made; 2% when form maintenance takes 0.7 rather than 0.5 hours per 100 baseline hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess people and their environments for health and safety needs.

steps.what: Review referral and relevant existing assessment information
Discuss needs and routines with individuals or families
Inspect living or work conditions and observe practical hazards
Judge health risks and prioritise assessment conclusions
Write and verify the assessment record
Commit the approved assessment record

tasks.design: Configure an assessment form in the clinical-record category of {OTHER}, with separate reported facts, observed hazards and nurse conclusions. Reuse patient and visit identifiers while retaining all interviews, inspections and clinical prioritisation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative forms repeatedly restate identifiers and standard assessment sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can supply headings and verified reference fields without generating conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden hazards, conflicting accounts and sensitive household circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and distinguish a practical risk from an assumption about a household.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less record formatting; assessment authority and visit duration are unchanged.

reach.task: Provide a clear environmental-hazard referral basis

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-12 for health-record access and relevant national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical assessment forms can separate factual observations from conclusions and reuse record identifiers.

assumptions: Boundary: direct assessment plus its written record, excluding subsequent treatment and referrals. The individual/family variant is modelled; community surveys need a separate volume model.

Referral producer supplies subject_id, referral_reason and prior_assessment_version. s2 supplies reported needs, s3 observed hazards, s4 conclusions; s5 captures visit_date, source_type, finding, risk_priority and rationale manually. Missing prior fields retain manual entry.
Test native form configuration first. Savings remove repeated headings and identifiers only. s6 is a near-zero native save, minimum share 1% fully retained.
Gross saving 4.2%; focal upkeep 0.8 gives central net 3.4%.
unknowns: Relative mix of home, work and community assessments
research_questions: Does the form preserve uncertainty and distinguish reported from observed facts?

already_counted.description: Write and verify the complete assessment

incremental.description: Review form relevance and outdated field labels

approvals.approved_version: approved assessment v1 with subject, final findings and risk rationale; any edit invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% where the current record already reuses headings and identifiers, with no new tool; 3% if manual reference corrections consume 0.4 extra baseline hours versus central 3.4% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and implement community health programs with individuals and families.

steps.what: Discuss community health priorities and participation barriers
Choose program activities, resources and health objectives
Write the program plan and participant invitation

loop.input: Nurse-selected activities, objectives, dates, resource limits and approved source paragraphs
loop.output: Program plan and plain-language invitation with source references
loop.check: s4 checks every claim, activity, date and accessibility statement against the selected outline and sources
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported content or missing details returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test a native template first; a bounded language draft is useful only where selected activities need varied plain-language explanation for a particular group.

steps.what: Correct and approve the final plan and invitation recipients
Save the approved program plan
Send the approved invitation to the approved participants
Deliver agreed sessions and adapt support to participant needs

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates first, adding a bounded drafting loop only for explanations drawn from nurse-selected program content. The nurse verifies meaning and the final contact list, saves the plan and authorises the exact invitation sent through {EMAIL}; community discussion and delivery stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing accessible program explanations and individually assembling invitations takes time.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled drafting and existing mail distribution can reuse an approved program packet.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing worthwhile activities, making participation practical and building local trust.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate goals with people rather than imposing a generic health program.

ambition.what: Offer an accessible program explanation to a group with lower health literacy.

tasks.altitude: Less prose assembly and sending; no new authority over program funding or clinical advice.

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-15 for contact permissions, health-data governance and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded source-grounded draft can support program writing, but program suitability and clinical claims require nurse review.

assumptions: Boundary includes the nurse's joint planning contribution, written program packet, invitation and delivery. Participant time is unchanged and excluded from focal baseline; nothing is transferred to participants.

s1 produces priorities; s2 records objective, audience, activity, date, venue, resource_limit and approved_source_paragraphs. The existing program coordinator maintains participant_contact, channel and contact_permission; s4 checks that list. Missing content or permission stops sending and retains manual work.
Test native templates and distribution controls first. s5 is a near-zero same-system save, minimum 1% fully retained. s6 replaces a real separately assembled external send, not that save.
Gross saving 11%; incremental focal upkeep 1.5 gives central net 9.5%.
unknowns: Actual program mix and invitation effort
research_questions: Can a template handle the program without a model?
Do reviewers catch altered health claims and misleading accessibility promises?

already_counted.description: Check final program meaning, dates and recipients

incremental.description: Audit draft fidelity and maintain program templates

approvals.approved_version: approved program packet v1 final plan; edits void approval
approved program packet v1 final invitation text, attachment and recipient snapshot; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% where a simple existing template and mail list already cover the work and no new tool is deployed; 8% if draft corrections add 1.5 baseline hours over central net 9.5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect reassessment, ward presence and community relationships while reducing repeated record formatting and program prose assembly.
reach: Support clinical nurse specialists with clearer care-quality follow-up
role.ambitious_version: A nurse with clearer records and accessible program materials who retains responsibility for clinical choices and face-to-face care.
